caseChecklist.title: Case checklist
caseChecklist.subtitle: Tasks materialized onto this case from the workflow task catalog. Settling every required task is what releases the submission gate.

empty.title: No checklist on this case yet
empty.description: Nothing has been materialized for this case. A checklist appears once the process that owns the case requests one from the catalog.

blocked.title: Submission is blocked
blocked.description: These required tasks are still outstanding. Every required task on the case is listed, because the projection cannot yet narrow them to a single phase.

projectionError.title: Outstanding required tasks could not be checked
projectionError.description: Whether this case is blocked from submission is unknown. Treat the checklist below as incomplete until this loads.

fields.statusHint: This cannot be changed once set.

gates.title: Phase gates
gates.subtitle: One gate per phase. A phase with no gate has not been decided yet.

fields.statusHint: An approved gate is final. A rejected gate can be reopened.
